description: This line plot illustrates the relationship between initial confidence and accuracy metrics for LLMs, showing three distinct measurements: Final Accuracy, Accuracy Change (Δ Acc), and Initial Accuracy. The x-axis represents Initial Confidence, scaled linearly from 0.95 to 0.99, with tick marks spaced at intervals of 0.01. The y-axis represents Accuracy, scaled linearly from 0.0 to 1.0. The blue line with circular markers represents Final Acc, starting at approximately 0.90 and ending near 0.85, showing a slight overall decline. The orange dashed line with diamond markers represents Δ Acc, beginning at approximately 0.90 and ending near 0.75, showing a consistent downward trend. The green dashed line with square markers represents Initial Acc, starting near 0.0 and ending near 0.15, showing a steady upward trend.
